recipes.oracle_text: Chandra's Outrage deals 4 damage to target creature and 2 damage to that creature's controller.

recipe_coverage: Targeted damage component: exact normal payment, legality, real responses, ordered stocked zones, cleanup, and AI/snapshot replay. Regeneration success follows documented legacy destruction-window timing. Additional abilities (alternate costs, graveyard casting, planeswalkers, uncounterability, damage prevention, equipment destruction, regeneration prohibition) require separate authored cases where present.
